title: arifOS Per-Call Envelope
description: Canonical metadata envelope attached to every tool call across the arifOS federation. Carries identity, authority, audit, and trace data. Required by WEALTH Reality Contract §6; replicated to all organs.

trace_id.description: End-to-end trace, propagated across all organs and tools. Format: trace-<uuid>.

session_id.description: arifOS constitutional session ID, returned by arif_session_init.

lease_id.description: Active arifOS lease ID. Format: LEASE-<scope>-<id>. lease_required by F8 LAW.

actor_id.description: Calling agent identity. Must be one of: arif, hermes, openclaw, opencode, AAA warga, A-FORGE worker, GEOX/WEALTH/WELL worker.

agent_class.description: Decision class per A-FORGE. C1=observe, C2=execute, C3=plan, C4=irreversible, C5=constitutional.

tool_name.description: Exact tool name as registered in the MCP server.

action_class.description: Action class per A-FORGE/src/interfaces/mcp/forgeTools.ts CLASS_RANK. Lower rank = higher severity.

floors_chain.description: Floor chain the call binds to. Always includes F1 (reversibility) and F2 (truth). EXECUTE_HIGH_IMPACT / IRREVERSIBLE must include F13.

gates_planned.description: Constitutional gates planned to run (organ-specific). For WEALTH: GAP1-GAP10 from wealth_gates.py.

gates_actually_run.description: Constitutional gates actually executed (post-call). Audit field.

approval_state.description: Approval state. open=pending, 888_HOLD=awaiting sovereign, sealed=approved, void=rejected.

args_hash.description: SHA-256 of the call arguments. For audit replay.

epistemic_label.description: Epistemic class of the expected output. OBS=observed, DER=derived, INT=interpreted, SPEC=speculation, UNKNOWN=insufficient.

human_actor.description: F13 SOVEREIGN signatory ID (only if approval_state=sealed and human_888_HOLD was required).

nda_token.description: Optional NDA token for restricted tools.

reverse_pointer.description: For EXECUTE_REVERSIBLE: pointer to the original txn / record that can revert this call.

output_hash.description: SHA-256 of the output payload. For audit replay.

gate_results.description: Per-gate results (post-call). Each gate emits a structured result.

vault_seal_id.description: VAULT999 seal ID for this call (if sealed). For EXECUTE_HIGH_IMPACT and IRREVERSIBLE, this is required.
